# Fix the __main__ block to call main() instead of doctest
with open('semver.py', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

old_main = """if __name__ == "__main__":
    import doctest
    doctest.testmod()"""

new_main = """if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())"""

content = content.replace(old_main, new_main)

with open('semver.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

print("Fixed __main__ block")
